intro: Arcade games, competitive play, virtual reality and sports on multiple screens — families and friends, go head to head.
source: Wacky's Design System (from wackys.com Game On header and Half Price Games feature)

items.name: Arcade Games
items.blurb: Rows of cabinets, ticket games and prizes. Load up a Play Card and go.

items.name: Virtual Reality
items.blurb: Strap in and step into another world between rounds of wings.

items.name: Air Hockey
items.blurb: Fast, loud and the best way to settle who pays.

items.name: Billiards
items.blurb: Rack 'em up while the game's on the big screen.

items.name: Tabletop Games
items.blurb: Grab the crew and claim a table.

items.name: Sports on Big Screens
items.blurb: Big screens on every wall, so you never miss a play.

playCard: Games run on Wacky's Play Cards. A $1 Play Card activation fee applies on combos.
scoreQuote: Whoever said that winning or losing doesn't matter clearly hasn't set foot in Wacky's.
